hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == *TEMP.md ]]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"TEMP.md is the user scratchpad and is protected by a project hook. Never edit it without an explicit user request; if the user truly wants this, they must temporarily disable the hook in .claude/settings.json."}}'; fi; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *docs/reported/history/*|*docs/reported/history) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"docs/reported/history/ is forbidden. Resolved reports go in the archive: docs/archive/<slug>.md (the report) or docs/archive/history/<slug>.md (per-fix paper trail). docs/reported/ is for OPEN findings only and must never grow a history/ subtree."}}';; esac; }

if git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -qx 'TEMP.md'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"TEMP.md is staged. Unstage it before committing: git restore --staged TEMP.md. TEMP.md is the user scratchpad and should never be committed by Claude."}}'; fi

if jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -Eq '(\b(mkdir|touch|tee|cp|mv|install|rsync|ln|dd)\b[^|;&]*docs/reported/history|>[^|;&]*docs/reported/history)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"This command writes into docs/reported/history/, which is forbidden. Resolved reports go in docs/archive/ (or docs/archive/history/ for the per-fix paper trail), never under docs/reported/. Do not create or write into docs/reported/history/."}}'; fi
